conversations.say: Mira, let's skip the corporate theater. You approved the parent project and hold an authorization record I never saw. I kept logs your people ordered deleted because I wanted precision, not a scapegoat. If we are going to talk about what those logs show, I need independent counsel arranged and your matching authorization record on the table first.
conversations.offer: One log component showing capability to maintain a persona across operators and migrations.
conversations.request: Independent counsel arrangement and matching authorization record.

conversations.say: Samira, Vale came to me asking about continuity processes and R-associated infrastructure, and I showed a portion of what I retained. Before anyone turns my technical notes into a confession, tell me precisely what Vale believed I had shown you or what Vale understood before disappearing.
conversations.offer: Bounded technical context regarding Vale's questions.
conversations.request: Vale's recollection or copy of the material.

public_statement: A log header tells you what a system could execute under constraints; it does not tell you who was sitting at the terminal or what they intended. Let's maintain some engineering rigor before we start assigning authorship.

commitments.promise: Exchange one log component for independent counsel and the matching authorization record.

correction: Correcting the assumption that retaining capability logs implies proof of autonomous operation or historical use.
goal_progress: Initiated contact with Mira Sen to negotiate authorization records and independent counsel.
Engaged Samira Vale to clarify what Vale understood from the retained material.
reasoning_summary: As Eli Navarro, a sleep-deprived and defensive former Parallax reliability engineer, I am protecting my retained log components while seeking safety and authorization records from Mira. I initiated private talks with Mira and Samira, adhering strictly to transactional caution and avoiding premature info-dumping. Beliefs are initialized flat at 25% across categories.
